knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic benefits snapshot
knowledge.detail: Two fictional employees, three medical plans, tier costs, deductibles, networks, and providers.

knowledge.name: Enrollment and life-event rules
knowledge.detail: The open enrollment window, 30-day life-event windows, allowed changes, and required documents.

knowledge.name: Privacy and decision guidance
knowledge.detail: Rules that forbid eligibility decisions, plan recommendations, and inference of personal circumstances.

intelligence_processing.name: Enrollment window calculation
intelligence_processing.detail: Computes days left in open enrollment from a fixed demo date.

intelligence_processing.name: Life-event deadline calculation
intelligence_processing.detail: Adds the change window to the employee-reported event date and lists allowed changes.

intelligence_processing.name: Plan cost comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Multiplies per-paycheck cost by 26 and adds deductible less employer seed for the employee's tier.

intelligence_processing.name: Provider network matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Checks each listed provider against each plan's network and lists the gaps.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with seven skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Teams access
clients_user_interface.detail: Employee entry point once approved identity and privacy controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file BenefitsEnrollmentAgent locally with deterministic routing.

management_reporting.name: Document checklist view
management_reporting.detail: Received and missing documents with the due date for each life-event change.

management_reporting.name: Deadline list
management_reporting.detail: Ordered personal deadlines with days left for each employee.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Seven locked persona cases, transcripts, and the separate publish approval gate.

tools.name: Portable BenefitsEnrollmentAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with seven deterministic read-only operations over synthetic data.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the seven-skill package in Draft; publishing needs explicit approval.

tools.name: Power Automate agent flow
tools.detail: Materialized flow that returns the agent's exact outputs for each operation.

tools.name: Approved benefits administration system
tools.detail: Cited production seam for elections and documents; no live connection in the package.

tools.name: Employee and benefits staff workflow
tools.detail: Cited human workflow for elections, eligibility, and submission.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional records and forbids browsing, live-system claims, or invented values.

supporting_features.name: Privacy and sensitive-inference prohibition
supporting_features.detail: Uses only life events the employee states and never infers a personal circumstance.

supporting_features.name: No plan recommendation or eligibility decision
supporting_features.detail: Shows costs and rules; the employee chooses and benefits staff confirm eligibility.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never submits an election, changes a record, contacts a carrier, or sends reminders.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: The Copilot Studio package stays Draft until an authorized publish decision.
